_**Your Weekly Deep Dive into The World of Crypto**_

**August 26, 2026 · ****5 Min Read**

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/ae0bda05-c93b-4ade-8fd6-53a598328d43/image.png?t=1787722700)
Caption: _As of August 26, 2026, morning ET | Sources: CoinGecko, Alternative.me, and SoSoValue_

## 📡** THIS WEEK IN CRYPTO**

**GM, Readers!**

What a week. The Fed did not move, but crypto behaved as it did. Bitcoin ripped past $77K, ETH cleared $2,500, and short sellers got flattened. A whale sold 7,700 BTC into the strength, BitMine crossed $14.9B in treasury, and a top market maker doubled its short book.

BTC closed Sunday at $77,775, per Coinglass, up 20.6% w/w. Spot BTC ETFs pulled in $1.92B (Aug 21), the largest weekly inflow of 2026.

_**Let’s get into it...**_


----------View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/6c53930f-b4d7-4e7d-baee-6a88bb56a6da/image.png?t=1781097813)
Caption: 

----------
# 🐋 THE BIG WHALE MOVES

### **1. The Mystery Whale Who Cashed Out $576M**

Between Aug 19 and 22, an unidentified wallet[ sold](https://x.com/lookonchain/status/2091079089692274893) 7,700 BTC, worth about $576M, per Lookonchain. The final leg was a 2,700 BTC dump with BTC near $80K.

Separately, address 3NVeXm[ deposited](https://x.com/lookonchain/status/2091336724815511680) 2,555 BTC ($197M) into Binance on Aug 22.

Another whale, bc1qsy,[ deposited](https://x.com/lookonchain/status/2090703346332279070) 3,000 BTC to Binance, extending a drip since July 19. Cumulative: 12,513.5 BTC, roughly $850M.

**Whale Intel: **When BTC is up 20% and whales keep sending coins to exchanges, that is selling into strength.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/ca274e58-444f-4745-a5ee-78b32ba06d55/image.jpeg?t=1787722756)
Caption: _Whale sell-off timeline  |  Source: Lookonchain, Aug 19 to 23, 2026_

### **2. BitMine Crosses $14.9B, Almost at 5% of ETH Supply**

On[ Aug 24](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/bitmine-immersion-technologies-bmnr-announces-eth-holdings-reach-5-85-million-tokens-and-total-crypto-and-total-cash-holdings-of-14-9-billion-302857967.html), BitMine posted its weekly update: 5,847,611 ETH (up 32,447 for the week), plus 210 BTC and $308M cash. Total portfolio: $14.9B, up from[ $11.4B](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/bitmine-immersion-technologies-bmnr-announces-eth-holdings-reach-5-82-million-tokens-and-total-crypto-and-total-cash-holdings-of-11-4-billion-302852583.html) a week earlier.

BitMine has bought ETH every week for 14 months straight. Its stack is 4.8% of supply, closing in on the 5% target.

**Whale Intel: **Corporate ETH treasuries are the anti-degen play. Buy, stake, hold. Boring works.

More details 🧮 Strategy Cuts Net Leverage to Near Zero Michael Saylor's bitcoin treasury company has brought its cash position almost level with its convertible debt, effectively neutralising net leverage. Strategy has also built close to four years of coverage for its preferred dividends while continuing to buy back STRC below par — a defensive posture that reshapes the risk profile of the largest corporate BTC holder.
